title: Russian Bao Bun Sliders
description: A fusion of Russian flavors in a soft, fluffy bao bun, filled with kissed beef and topped with molten cheese.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Add a small amount of oil to the grill and cook the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
3. Meanwhile, toast the bao buns on the grill or in a toaster.
4. Assemble the sliders by spreading a small amount of mayonnaise or mustard on the bottom bun, if using.
5. Add a few slices of the cooked beef, followed by a slice of molten cheese.
6. Top with a sprinkle of chopped Russian dill and a few slices of onion.
7. Place the top bun on the slider and serve immediately.
